item.title: Several Worshippers Kidnapped In Nigeria Church Attack As Concerns Persist - Worthy Christian News
item.description: Concerns remained Tuesday about the whereabouts of several worshippers who were abducted Sunday when gunmen attacked the Evangelical Church of West Africa (ECWA) in Nigeria’s north-central Kwara State, police said.

item.title: Footage Shows Deadly Plane Collision With Fire Truck, Raising Questions - Worthy Christian News
item.description: Footage apparently taken from an air traffic control tower showed a fire truck crossing a runway before being struck by an Air Canada Express plane at New York’s LaGuardia Airport.

item.title: Hungary FM Admits Russia Contacts As EU Leak Claims Spark ‘Treason’ Row (Worthy News Investigation) - Worthy Christian News
item.description: Hungary’s foreign minister has admitted contacts with Russia during European Union meetings, after reports that confidential information from closed-door discussions may have been shared—an allegation the opposition says could amount to “treason” and carry a potential life sentence in prison.

item.title: Gulf States Move Toward Joining Operation Against Iran Alongside U.S. And Israel As Middle East Rapidly Shifts - Worthy Christian News
item.description: Arab Gulf nations are moving closer to joining the expanding military campaign against Iran, signaling a dramatic shift in regional dynamics as sustained Iranian attacks strain their economies and threaten control of critical energy routes, the Wall Street Journal reported.

item.title: Lebanon Expels Iranian Envoy, Escalates Diplomatic Break With Tehran - Worthy Christian News
item.description: Lebanon sharply escalated tensions with Iran on Tuesday, announcing the expulsion of Tehran’s ambassador-designate and recalling its own envoy amid accusations of diplomatic violations and growing concerns over Iranian influence in the country.

item.title: Trump Backed At CPAC Over Iran Strikes As Protests Sweep US - Worthy Christian News
item.description: While organizers claimed millions protested against him, Reverend Franklin Graham and Republicans at the annual Conservative Political Action Conference (CPAC) rallied behind U.S. President Donald J. Trump and his strikes on Iran.

item.title: Spain Bars U.S. Military Flights From Airspace Amid Iran War Dispute - Worthy Christian News
item.description: Spain has formally blocked U.S. military aircraft involved in the Iran conflict from using its airspace and bases, marking a significant rift between NATO allies as tensions escalate in the Middle East.

item.title: Knesset Passes Landmark Death Penalty Law For Terrorists In Israel - Worthy Christian News
item.description: The Knesset approved a controversial law Monday mandating the death penalty for certain terrorist acts, marking a historic shift in Israel’s judicial approach to terrorism.

item.title: Trump Issues Ultimatum To Iran As Ceasefire Talks Hang In Balance - Worthy Christian News
item.description: U.S. President Donald Trump delivered a stark ultimatum Monday, warning Iran that failure to reach a ceasefire agreement in the coming days would trigger a sweeping and devastating assault on the country’s critical infrastructure.

item.title: U.S. Reopens Venezuelan Embassy After Seven-year Closure - Worthy Christian News
item.description: The U.S. officially reopened its embassy in Caracas on Monday for the first time after its ousting of former Venezuelan President Nicolas Maduro.

item.title: U.S. Deploys 82nd Airborne To Middle East As Trump Weighs Next Phase In Iran War - Worthy Christian News
item.description: Thousands of troops from the 82nd Airborne Division have begun arriving in the Middle East, according to U.S. officials, as President Donald Trump considers expanded military options in the ongoing conflict with Iran.

item.title: IAEA Confirms Destruction Of Iran’s Arak Heavy Water Facility Following Israeli Strike - Worthy Christian News
item.description: The International Atomic Energy Agency (IAEA) has confirmed that Iran’s Arak heavy water production plant was destroyed following a targeted strike attributed to the Israel Defense Forces, marking a significant escalation in efforts to dismantle Tehran’s nuclear infrastructure.

item.title: FBI: Hezbollah Propaganda Inspired Deadly Synagogue Attack Near Detroit - Worthy Christian News
item.description: Federal investigators say a man who carried out a violent vehicle-ramming attack at a Michigan synagogue earlier this month was driven by extremist propaganda linked to Hezbollah, underscoring growing concerns about foreign terror influence reaching U.S. soil.

item.title: U.S. Officials Warn Of Potential Iranian Sleeper Cell Threat Amid Border Concerns - Worthy Christian News
item.description: U.S. officials are raising concerns about the potential presence of Iranian “sleeper cells” inside the United States, as tensions escalate following recent American and Israeli strikes on Iran.

item.title: Christian Congregation Attacked, Pastor Injured In India Amid Rising Tensions Over Anti-Conversion Laws - Worthy Christian News
item.description: A group of radical Hindu nationalists violently attacked a small Christian congregation in Maharashtra, India, on February 10, leaving a pastor seriously injured and forcing believers to flee their village.
